items.headline: NFL Week 1 uniforms: Vikings rocking throwbacks, Bengals go orange
items.description: The NFL is back, and so are the uniform combinations. Here's a look at what each team is wearing in Week 1.

items.headline: Sources: C.J. Stroud, Texans to table extension talks
items.description: The Texans and C.J. Stroud made a run at completing a contract extension before the regular season begins, but both sides agreed they now prefer to wait until after this season to work out a long-term deal, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

items.headline: Texans rookie Kayden McDonald placed on IR with ankle injury
items.description: Texans rookie defensive tackle Kayden McDonald (ankle) was placed on injured reserve, meaning he'll have to wait four weeks to make his debut.

items.headline: Which NFL teams have never won a Super Bowl?
items.description: Some NFL teams have scored multiple Lombardi trophies, but which franchises have never won the Super Bowl? Check out more information now.

items.headline: Six NFL records that could be broken during the 2026 season
items.description: Can a team break the NFL's rushing record? Will we see a new long in field goal kicking? Could there be a new single-season tight end receiving yardage mark?

items.headline: Bills QB Josh Allen seeks to end 0-4 skid in Houston as Joe Brady debuts as Buffalo head coach
items.description: — Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills travel to Houston to Sunday to open their season against the Texans with the quarterback looking to finally break through in a place that has never been good to him.
